_comment: How a spec's acceptance criteria checks level resolves for analyze.
`aide-run-spec` reads it off the spec's own 1-description.md (aide_spec_criteria_checks).
`description` is the value written after `- **Acceptance criteria checks:**` in the
description's Tracking info; null means the line is not written at all.
`level` is what analyze is told: absent or unknown is off.
